# Equipment Catalog Archetypes

Generic equipment archetypes for energysim.

Every factory in this module is an **illustrative archetype, not calibrated to an OEM
datasheet**: the parameters are round, plausible figures for the equipment class and carry
no manufacturer endorsement or data-sheet provenance. See ``PROVENANCE`` for the source
status of each archetype.

The manufacturer-branded names of earlier versions (``Tesla_Megapack_2XL``,
``Fluence_Gridstack``, ``Nel_A1000``, ``ITM_Power_Trident``, ``Bloom_Energy_SOEC``,
``GE_7HA_02``, ``Siemens_SGT_800``, ``Wartsila_34SG``, ``CanadianSolar_HiKu7``,
``Vestas_V150_4MW``) are kept as **deprecated aliases**: they emit a
``DeprecationWarning`` and return the generic archetype configured with the numbers the old
name used. They will be removed in a future release.

## Archetypes

| Factory | Builds | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog.BESS_2h_2MW` | `BatteryBESS` | Generic 2-hour Li-ion BESS (2 MW / 4 MWh). Round figures; no datasheet source. |
| `catalog.BESS_4h_2MW` | `BatteryBESS` | Generic 4-hour Li-ion BESS (2 MW / 8 MWh). Round figures; no datasheet source. |
| `catalog.Alkaline_2MW` | `AlkalineElectrolyzer` | Generic atmospheric alkaline electrolyzer, 2 MW, ~52 kWh/kg system consumption (typical literature range 50-55). Not an OEM datasheet. |
| `catalog.PEM_5MW` | `PEMElectrolyzer` | Generic 5 MW PEM electrolyzer with an illustrative lookup polarization curve. Not fitted to any stack. |
| `catalog.SOEC_1MW` | `SOECElectrolyzer` | Generic 1 MW solid-oxide electrolyzer, ~37.5 kWh/kg electricity (heat supplied externally). Not an OEM datasheet. |
| `catalog.CCGT_570MW` | `CombinedCycle_CCGT` | Generic large-frame combined cycle, ~64 % LHV net at full load. Round figures; no datasheet source. |
| `catalog.Gas_Turbine_60MW` | `GasTurbine_OCGT` | Generic industrial open-cycle gas turbine, ~39 % LHV. No datasheet source. |
| `catalog.Gas_Engine_10MW` | `ReciprocatingGenset` | Generic lean-burn gas genset, 47 % electrical / 41 % heat recovery. No datasheet source. |
| `catalog.Solar_Farm` | `PhysicsPV` | Generic utility PV plant, 1.25 DC/AC ratio, -0.34 %/K. No datasheet source. |
| `catalog.Wind_Turbine_4MW` | `WindTurbine` | Generic 4 MW onshore turbine with a simple cubic power curve between cut-in and rated wind speed. No datasheet source. |

## Deprecated manufacturer-named aliases

These names emit a `DeprecationWarning` and will be removed. They are **not** backed by OEM datasheets.

| Alias | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `catalog.Tesla_Megapack_2XL` | DEPRECATED alias of BESS_2h_2MW; keeps the old 1.929 MW / 3.916 MWh numbers which are not backed by a cited datasheet. |
| `catalog.Fluence_Gridstack` | DEPRECATED alias of BESS_4h_2MW; old numbers not backed by a cited datasheet. |
| `catalog.Nel_A1000` | DEPRECATED alias of Alkaline_2MW; keeps the old 2.2 MW figure, which is suspect (a 1000 Nm3/h machine would be ~4.5 MW) and unsourced. |
| `catalog.ITM_Power_Trident` | DEPRECATED alias of PEM_5MW; numbers unsourced. |
| `catalog.Bloom_Energy_SOEC` | DEPRECATED alias of SOEC_1MW; numbers unsourced. |
| `catalog.GE_7HA_02` | DEPRECATED alias of CCGT_570MW; keeps the old 573 MW figure, unsourced. |
| `catalog.Siemens_SGT_800` | DEPRECATED alias of Gas_Turbine_60MW; keeps the old 62 MW figure, unsourced. |
| `catalog.Wartsila_34SG` | DEPRECATED alias of Gas_Engine_10MW; keeps the old 9.7 MW figure, unsourced. |
| `catalog.CanadianSolar_HiKu7` | DEPRECATED alias of Solar_Farm; numbers unsourced. |
| `catalog.Vestas_V150_4MW` | DEPRECATED alias of Wind_Turbine_4MW; keeps the old 4.2 MW figure, unsourced. |

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import catalog

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
bess = catalog.BESS_2h_2MW(name='bess', soc_init=0.5)
sim.add_model('bess', model=bess, outputs=['P_actual', 'SoC'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['bess'].tail(2))
```
